claims.object_text: PCDH19 clustering epilepsy (distinct etiology of epilepsy)
claims.quote: PCDH19 gene variants, termed PCDH19 clustering epilepsy, represent a distinct etiology of epilepsy.

claims.object_text: age at seizure onset 5 to 61 months (median 14 months)
claims.quote: The age at seizure onset ranged from 5 to 61 months among all 30 patients (median 14 months; IQR 9.25-22.5 months).
Among the 30 patients, 29 were female and 1 was male.

claims.object_text: clusters of seizures and fever-triggered seizures
claims.quote: Clusters of seizures and fever-triggered seizures were observed, with the most prevalent seizure types being focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizures (FBTCS).

claims.object_text: focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizures (FBTCS) as most prevalent seizure type
claims.quote: with the most prevalent seizure types being focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizures (FBTCS).
Seizures were successfully controlled in 15 patients.

claims.object_text: sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) in one patient
claims.quote: Unfortunately, one patient experienced a sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP).
Developmental delays were identified in 17 patients (56.7 %), and 6 patients (20 %) were diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder (ASD).

claims.object_text: timing of developmental delay relative to epilepsy onset
claims.quote: Among the 17 patients, 9 experienced developmental delays before the onset of epilepsy, while 8 were initially normal but later developed developmental delays during disease progression.

claims.object_text: genetic mutation types: hereditary, de novo, both, mosaic (0.64 somatic in one male)
claims.quote: Additionally, 14 patients had hereditary mutations, 14 had de novo mutations, 1 had both hereditary and de novo mutations, and 1 male patient had a mosaic component mutation of 0.64 due to a somatic mutation.

claims.object_text: drug-resistant epilepsy is an independent risk factor for developmental delays
claims.quote: Statistical analysis revealed that the presence of drug-resistant epilepsy was an independent risk factor for the occurrence of developmental delays (P = 0.020, OR = 9.758, 95 % CI (1.440-66.111)).

claims.object_text: identification of 13 new potential rare pathogenic variations in PCDH19
claims.quote: In this study, 13 new potential rare pathogenic variations in PCDH19 clustering epilepsy were identified.

claims.object_text: phenotypic severity ranged from drug-responsive seizures to refractory epilepsy
claims.quote: The severity of the phenotype in patients with PCDH19 variants ranged from drug-responsive seizures to refractory epilepsy.
